msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia cast-tejidos-39.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of red polka dot flamenco fabric folded from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia cast-tejidos-39.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of white fabric with red polka dots from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia cast-tejidos-25.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of black and white polka dot fabrics and teal with white dots from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia cast-tejidos-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a black fabric embroidered with pink flowers and green leaves from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
